CustomField.description: Live coverage of this unit from its current coverage plan: Covered, Expired or Not Covered. Calculated when read, never stored (SVC-03). Reused by Case and the Agentforce action.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISBLANK(Current_Coverage_Plan__c), ISPICKVAL(Current_Coverage_Plan__r.Status__c, "Draft") ), "Not Covered", IF( OR( ISPICKVAL(Current_Coverage_Plan__r.Status__c, "Expired"), Current_Coverage_Plan__r.End_Date__c < TODAY() ), "Expired", IF( Current_Coverage_Plan__r.Start_Date__c <= TODAY(), "Covered", "Not Covered" ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Covered = active plan running today. Expired = plan ended. Not Covered = no plan, draft plan, or plan not started yet.
CustomField.label: Coverage Position
